connector.name: ABAPilot
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for SAP ECC and on-premise S/4HANA: natural-language queries and ABAP dev tooling.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package abapilot. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nicohern account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ABAPILOT_URL
env.description: URL of the ABAPilot SICF endpoint in your SAP system, e.g. https://sap-host:8443/sap/bc/abapilot

env.name: ABAPILOT_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token, alternative to basic authentication

env.name: ABAPILOT_TLS_INSECURE
env.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification (development systems only)
